query: WITH targets AS (SELECT unnest(ARRAY['user_progress','edutech_progress','favorites','edutech_favorites']) AS table_name), constraints AS (SELECT tc.table_name, tc.constraint_name, tc.constraint_type, coalesce(string_agg(kcu.column_name, ', ' ORDER BY kcu.ordinal_position), '') AS columns FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu ON kcu.constraint_schema=tc.constraint_schema AND kcu.constraint_name=tc.constraint_name AND kcu.table_name=tc.table_name WHERE tc.table_schema='public' AND tc.table_name IN (SELECT table_name FROM targets) GROUP BY tc.table_name,tc.constraint_name,tc.constraint_type), policies AS (SELECT tablename AS table_name, policyname, cmd, coalesce(qual,'') AS using_expression, coalesce(with_check,'') AS check_expression FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN (SELECT table_name FROM targets)), counts AS (SELECT 'user_progress' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT (user_id,lesson_id)) AS distinct_pairs FROM public.user_progress UNION ALL SELECT 'edutech_progress', count(*), count(DISTINCT id) FROM public.edutech_progress UNION ALL SELECT 'favorites', count(*), count(DISTINCT (user_id,content_type,content_id)) FROM public.favorites UNION ALL SELECT 'edutech_favorites', count(*), count(DISTINCT (user_id,content_type,content_id)) FROM public.edutech_favorites) SELECT 'constraint' AS audit_type, table_name || ' / ' || constraint_name AS key, constraint_type || ' / ' || columns AS value FROM constraints UNION ALL SELECT 'policy' AS audit_type, table_name || ' / ' || policyname AS key, cmd || ' / USING: ' || using_expression || ' / CHECK: ' || check_expression AS value FROM policies UNION ALL SELECT 'count' AS audit_type, table_name AS key, row_count::text || ' rows; ' || distinct_pairs::text || ' distinct pairs' AS value FROM counts ORDER BY audit_type,key;
